accommodation.en: The university offers cheap accommodation to all first-year students.
accommodation.zh: 这所大学为所有大一新生提供便宜的住宿。

landlord.en: The landlord has agreed to replace the broken cooker by next Monday.
landlord.zh: 房东已经同意在下周一前换掉坏了的灶具。

landlady.en: My landlady lives downstairs and doesn't allow pets in the house.
landlady.zh: 我的女房东住在楼下,她不允许在房子里养宠物。

tenant.en: The tenant must report any repairs to the landlord within two days.
tenant.zh: 租户必须在两天内向房东报修。

lease.en: We signed a one-year lease, so we can't move out before June.
lease.zh: 我们签了一年的租约,所以六月之前不能搬走。

lease.en: The company leases three flats near the station to its new staff.
lease.zh: 公司把车站附近的三套公寓租给新员工。

tenancy.en: The tenancy runs for twelve months and starts on the first of September.
tenancy.zh: 租期为十二个月,从九月一日开始。

rent.en: The rent is due on the first day of every month.
rent.zh: 租金在每月第一天到期。

rent.en: We decided to rent a small house close to the beach.
rent.zh: 我们决定在海滩附近租一栋小房子。

security-deposit.en: You'll get your security deposit back when you move out of the flat.
security-deposit.zh: 你搬出公寓时,押金会退还给你。

utilities.en: Does the monthly rent include utilities such as gas and electricity?
utilities.zh: 月租包含煤气、电费这类费用吗?

bill.en: Could you pay the electricity bill before you go on holiday?
bill.zh: 你去度假前能把电费账单付了吗?

inclusive.en: The rent is £150 a week, inclusive of gas and water.
inclusive.zh: 租金每周 150 英镑,包含煤气费和水费。

furnished.en: The flat is fully furnished, so you won't need to buy a bed.
furnished.zh: 这套公寓家具齐全,所以你不用买床。

unfurnished.en: It's cheaper because it's unfurnished, but you'll need to buy your own sofa.
unfurnished.zh: 它不带家具,所以更便宜,但你得自己买沙发。

apartment.en: I'm looking for a two-bedroom apartment close to the city centre.
apartment.zh: 我在找一套靠近市中心的两居室公寓。

flat.en: My friend and I share a flat above a small bakery.
flat.zh: 我和朋友合住在一家小面包店楼上的公寓里。

flat.en: The house has a flat roof, which often leaks in heavy rain.
flat.zh: 这栋房子是平屋顶,下大雨时经常漏水。

studio.en: I rented a studio near campus because it was cheaper than a shared house.
studio.zh: 我在学校附近租了一间单间公寓,因为比合租房子便宜。

studio.en: The radio studio is on the third floor, next to the lifts.
studio.zh: 广播演播室在三楼,就在电梯旁边。

semi-detached.en: They live in a semi-detached house with a small garden at the back.
semi-detached.zh: 他们住在一栋半独立式房屋里,屋后有个小花园。

detached-house.en: A detached house costs a lot more than a flat in this area.
detached-house.zh: 在这一带,独栋房屋比公寓贵得多。

terraced-house.en: Our terraced house shares walls with the neighbours on both sides.
terraced-house.zh: 我们的联排房屋与两边的邻居共用墙壁。

cottage.en: We rented a small cottage in the countryside for the summer holidays.
cottage.zh: 暑假期间我们在乡下租了一间小屋。

dormitory.en: Each dormitory has four beds and a shared bathroom on the same floor.
dormitory.zh: 每间宿舍有四张床,同层有公用浴室。

hall-of-residence.en: Most first-year students live in a hall of residence on campus.
hall-of-residence.zh: 大多数大一新生住在校内的学生宿舍楼。

homestay.en: A homestay is a good way to practise English with a local family.
homestay.zh: 家庭寄宿是和当地家庭一起练习英语的好方式。

host-family.en: My host family picked me up from the airport and cooked me dinner.
host-family.zh: 我的寄宿家庭到机场接我,还给我做了晚饭。

suburb.en: We moved to a quiet suburb about thirty minutes from the city centre.
suburb.zh: 我们搬到了一个安静的郊区,距离市中心大约三十分钟。

outskirts.en: The new hospital is on the outskirts of town, near the motorway.
outskirts.zh: 新医院在市郊,靠近高速公路。

neighbourhood.en: It's a friendly neighbourhood with plenty of shops and a small park.
neighbourhood.zh: 这是一个氛围友好的社区,有很多商店和一个小公园。

amenity.en: The nearest amenities, such as shops and a bank, are within walking distance.
amenity.zh: 最近的商店、银行等便利设施走路就能到。

convenience.en: For your convenience, we've put a map of the area in every room.
convenience.zh: 为了方便您,我们在每个房间都放了一张周边地图。

commute.en: Many of our staff commute to London by train every day.
commute.zh: 我们很多员工每天乘火车去伦敦上班。

commute.en: My commute takes about an hour each way, so I leave home early.
commute.zh: 我单程通勤大约要一小时,所以很早就出门。

balcony.en: The bedroom has a small balcony with a lovely view of the sea.
balcony.zh: 卧室有一个小阳台,能看到美丽的海景。

basement.en: You can keep your bikes in the basement, next to the washing machines.
basement.zh: 你可以把自行车放在地下室,就在洗衣机旁边。

attic.en: We turned the attic into an extra bedroom for our son.
attic.zh: 我们把阁楼改成了儿子的卧室。

corridor.en: The kitchen is at the end of the corridor, on your left.
corridor.zh: 厨房在走廊尽头,在你的左手边。

courtyard.en: All the flats look onto a courtyard with benches and a few trees.
courtyard.zh: 所有公寓都朝向一个庭院,里面有长椅和几棵树。

driveway.en: You can park in the driveway, but please don't block the garage.
driveway.zh: 你可以把车停在私家车道上,但请不要挡住车库。

garage.en: The house comes with a garage big enough for two cars.
garage.zh: 这栋房子带一个能停两辆车的车库。

fence.en: The fence between the two gardens was damaged in last week's storm.
fence.zh: 两个花园之间的围栏在上周的暴风雨中损坏了。

lounge.en: Residents can watch television or relax in the lounge on the ground floor.
lounge.zh: 住户可以在一楼的休息室看电视或放松。

en-suite.en: Every bedroom is en-suite, so you won't need to share a shower.
en-suite.zh: 每间卧室都带独立卫浴,所以你不用和别人共用淋浴。

shared-bathroom.en: The cheaper rooms come with a shared bathroom at the end of the hall.
shared-bathroom.zh: 便宜一些的房间使用走廊尽头的公用卫生间。

communal.en: The communal kitchen must be kept clean by everyone who uses it.
communal.zh: 公用厨房要靠每个使用者保持干净。

laundry.en: The laundry is in the basement and is open until ten at night.
laundry.zh: 洗衣房在地下室,开放到晚上十点。

laundry.en: I usually do my laundry on Sunday mornings when the machines are free.
laundry.zh: 我通常周日上午洗衣服,那时洗衣机都空着。

wardrobe.en: There's a large wardrobe in the bedroom for your clothes and shoes.
wardrobe.zh: 卧室里有一个大衣柜,可以放你的衣服和鞋子。

mattress.en: The old mattress was so hard that I asked for a new one.
mattress.zh: 旧床垫太硬了,所以我要求换一张新的。

pillowcase.en: Clean sheets and pillowcases are provided once a week.
pillowcase.zh: 每周提供一次干净的床单和枕套。

blanket.en: You'll find an extra blanket in the cupboard if you get cold.
blanket.zh: 如果觉得冷,橱柜里还有一条毯子。

duvet.en: Please bring your own duvet, as bedding isn't provided.
duvet.zh: 请自带被子,这里不提供床上用品。

curtain.en: The new curtains keep out the light from the street lamps.
curtain.zh: 新窗帘能挡住路灯的光。

microwave.en: There's a microwave in the kitchen, but students must bring their own plates.
microwave.zh: 厨房里有微波炉,但学生要自带盘子。

refrigerator.en: Please label your food before you put it in the shared refrigerator.
refrigerator.zh: 把食物放进公用冰箱前,请先贴上标签。

dishwasher.en: The dishwasher isn't working, so we'll have to wash everything by hand.
dishwasher.zh: 洗碗机坏了,所以我们只能全部手洗。

vacuum-cleaner.en: You can borrow a vacuum cleaner from the office on the ground floor.
vacuum-cleaner.zh: 你可以到一楼办公室借吸尘器。

heater.en: The small heater in the bedroom uses a lot of electricity.
heater.zh: 卧室里的小取暖器很费电。

central-heating.en: The flat has central heating, so it stays warm all winter.
central-heating.zh: 这套公寓有集中供暖,所以整个冬天都很暖和。

air-conditioning.en: All the rooms have air conditioning, which is useful in hot weather.
air-conditioning.zh: 所有房间都有空调,天热时很有用。

socket.en: There's only one socket in the room, so I bought an extension lead.
socket.zh: 房间里只有一个插座,所以我买了一个接线板。

plumber.en: We called a plumber because water was coming through the kitchen ceiling.
plumber.zh: 水从厨房天花板渗下来,所以我们叫了水管工。

leak.en: There's a leak under the sink, so the floor is always wet.
leak.zh: 水槽下面漏水,所以地板总是湿的。

leak.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains, so we've put a bucket upstairs.
leak.zh: 一下雨屋顶就漏水,所以我们在楼上放了个桶。

maintenance.en: Please report any maintenance problems to the office as soon as possible.
maintenance.zh: 如有任何需要维修的问题,请尽快告知办公室。

repair.en: The landlord must pay for any repairs to the roof.
repair.zh: 屋顶的任何修理费用都必须由房东支付。

repair.en: Someone will come to repair the washing machine on Tuesday morning.
repair.zh: 周二上午会有人来修洗衣机。

inspection.en: The landlord will carry out an inspection of the flat every six months.
inspection.zh: 房东每六个月会检查一次公寓。

spacious.en: The living room is spacious enough for a large sofa and a dining table.
spacious.zh: 客厅很宽敞,放得下一张大沙发和一张餐桌。

cosy.en: It's only a small room, but it feels warm and cosy in winter.
cosy.zh: 房间虽小,但冬天感觉温暖又舒适。

parking-space.en: Each flat comes with one parking space behind the building.
parking-space.zh: 每套公寓都配有一个位于楼后的停车位。

postcode.en: Could you give me your postcode so I can find the address?
postcode.zh: 能告诉我你的邮编吗?这样我好查地址。

reference.en: The agency asked for a reference from my previous landlord.
reference.zh: 中介要求我提供前房东的推荐信。

reference.en: Please keep this guide for future reference during your stay here.
reference.zh: 住在这里期间,请保留这份指南以便日后参考。

bedsit.en: As a student, I lived in a tiny bedsit with a cooker beside the bed.
bedsit.zh: 上学时我住在一间很小的单间出租房里,灶具就在床边。

flatmate.en: My flatmate and I take turns to clean the kitchen and bathroom.
flatmate.zh: 我和合租室友轮流打扫厨房和浴室。

suite.en: The hotel upgraded us to a suite with a separate living room.
suite.zh: 酒店把我们升级到了带独立客厅的套房。

fireplace.en: The cottage has an old fireplace, but it's no longer safe to use.
fireplace.zh: 小屋里有一个旧壁炉,但已经不能安全使用了。

radiator.en: The radiator in my room isn't getting hot, even with the heating on.
radiator.zh: 即使开了暖气,我房间的暖气片也不热。

foyer.en: Please wait for me in the foyer, just inside the main doors.
foyer.zh: 请在门厅等我,一进正门就是。

storeroom.en: Residents can leave their suitcases in the storeroom during the holidays.
storeroom.zh: 假期里住户可以把行李箱放在储藏室。

lift.en: The lift is out of order, so you'll have to use the stairs.
lift.zh: 电梯坏了,所以你只能走楼梯。

shutter.en: We close the shutters at night to keep out the noise.
shutter.zh: 我们晚上会关上百叶窗,挡住外面的噪音。

cupboard.en: The plates and glasses are in the cupboard above the sink.
cupboard.zh: 盘子和杯子在水槽上方的橱柜里。

armchair.en: There's a comfortable armchair next to the window for reading.
armchair.zh: 窗边有一把舒服的扶手椅,可以坐着看书。

stool.en: The kitchen has a narrow counter with two stools.
stool.zh: 厨房有一个窄窄的吧台,配了两张凳子。

bedspread.en: The guest room has a matching bedspread and curtains in pale blue.
bedspread.zh: 客房的床罩和窗帘是配套的淡蓝色。

washbasin.en: Each room has its own washbasin, but the toilets are shared.
washbasin.zh: 每个房间都有自己的洗脸盆,但厕所是公用的。

lavatory.en: The only lavatory is on the ground floor, next to the back door.
lavatory.zh: 唯一的厕所在一楼,就在后门旁边。

toaster.en: Please don't use the toaster in your room because of the smoke alarm.
toaster.zh: 房间里有烟雾报警器,请不要在房间里使用烤面包机。

letting-agency.en: I found this flat through a letting agency near the university.
letting-agency.zh: 我是通过大学附近的一家租房中介找到这套公寓的。

real-estate-agency.en: A real estate agency can help you find a house to buy.
real-estate-agency.zh: 房地产中介可以帮你找到想买的房子。

studio-apartment.en: A studio apartment has just one main room for sleeping, cooking and relaxing.
studio-apartment.zh: 单间公寓只有一个主要房间,睡觉、做饭和休息都在里面。

tenancy-agreement.en: Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign it and pay the deposit.
tenancy-agreement.zh: 签字和付押金之前,请仔细阅读租赁合同。

plug.en: My laptop charger has a different plug, so I need an adapter.
plug.zh: 我的笔记本充电器插头不一样,所以需要一个转换器。

plug.en: Just plug the fridge in and wait an hour before using it.
plug.zh: 给冰箱接通电源后,等一小时再用。

lawn.en: Tenants are responsible for cutting the lawn during the summer months.
lawn.zh: 夏季由租户负责修剪草坪。

terrace.en: We often eat outside on the terrace when the weather is warm.
terrace.zh: 天气暖和时,我们常在露台上吃饭。

terrace.en: Our house is in the middle of a long terrace of brick homes.
terrace.zh: 我们家位于一长排砖砌排屋的中间。

porch.en: You can leave the parcel in the porch if nobody answers the door.
porch.zh: 如果没人应门,可以把包裹放在门廊里。

closet.en: The flat has a closet in the hall for coats and boots.
closet.zh: 公寓门厅有一个壁橱,可以放外套和靴子。

cellar.en: The house has a cellar, but it's too damp for storing anything.
cellar.zh: 这栋房子有地窖,但太潮湿,放不了东西。

cushion.en: We bought some bright cushions to make the old sofa look better.
cushion.zh: 我们买了一些鲜艳的靠垫,让旧沙发好看一点。

bungalow.en: My grandparents moved to a bungalow because they can't manage the stairs.
bungalow.zh: 我的祖父母搬到了平房,因为他们爬不动楼梯了。

mansion.en: The old mansion on the hill has over twenty bedrooms and its own lake.
mansion.zh: 山上那座老豪宅有二十多间卧室,还有自己的湖。

roommate.en: My roommate goes to bed early, so I study in the library at night.
roommate.zh: 我的室友睡得早,所以我晚上去图书馆学习。

tile.en: Several bathroom tiles are cracked and need replacing.
tile.zh: 浴室有几块瓷砖裂了,需要更换。

bulb.en: The bulb in the hall has gone, so we need a new one.
bulb.zh: 门厅的灯泡坏了,所以我们需要换个新的。

bulb.en: We planted some tulip bulbs along the fence last autumn.
bulb.zh: 去年秋天我们沿着围栏种了一些郁金香球茎。

mould.en: There's mould on the bathroom ceiling because the room has no window.
mould.zh: 浴室没有窗户,所以天花板上长了霉。

mould.en: The workers pour the hot metal into a mould and leave it to cool.
mould.zh: 工人把热金属倒入模具,然后让它冷却。
